option_relations.rationale: Severe SARS-CoV-2 infection is a specific viral infection, while Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) is a general condition of respiratory failure. While SARS-CoV-2 can lead to RDS, the option is not a direct manifestation, mechanism, or equivalent of the provided leaf.

Bacterial pneumonia is an infection, while Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) is a general condition of respiratory failure. While bacterial pneumonia can cause RDS, the option is not a direct manifestation, mechanism, or equivalent of the provided leaf.

Healthcare-associated Pneumonia is a type of infection, while Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) is a general condition of respiratory failure. While this type of pneumonia can cause RDS, the option is not a direct manifestation, mechanism, or equivalent of the provided leaf.

Viral Pneumonitis is an inflammation of the lung due to a virus, while Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) is a general condition of respiratory failure. While viral pneumonitis can cause RDS, the option is not a direct manifestation, mechanism, or equivalent of the provided leaf.
